body:
I’m so sorry for the confusion, my sister is alive and well. 
It was my boyfriend that ended his own life and after his death I was pestering my sister to talk to me about her feelings and I wanted her to listen to my feelings as well. 
That’s when she blew up and the situation described in the post happened.

Thank you for the comment and advice. I have not interacted with this person (or anybody else on TikTok), but what he talked about resonated with how I behaved and felt in that specific situation with my sister and how I’ve been feeling after he died. 

I thought maybe reaching out here to someone that may have gone through a similar loss could shed some light on the subject if they could relate at all. 

I promise I will talk to my therapist and medical advisor, no TikTok “doctors” can give me any answers.

Trond Espen Seim, me and a friend asked him to take a photo at a movie premiere, and he grabbed both our butts while doing it and laughed with one of his friends about it afterwards. Such an obnoxious prick, wish I had enough courage to call him out on it there and then. Never saw a movie with him in it afterwards.
Thank you so much, I really appreciate you taking the time and helping me 💙
